{{Quote|We have you on our screen now. Please identify.|Jhoff to Han Solo piloting the shuttle ''Tydirium''|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
'''Kasva Jhoff''' was a member of the [[Imperial Navy]] who served as a [[Flight controller]] onboard the [[Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Executor]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shuttle Tydirium, deactivation of the shield will commence immediately. Follow your present course.|Kasva Jhoff to the shuttle ''Tydirium''|<ref name="ROTJ" />}}
Kasva Jhoff was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was born on the [[planet]] [[Abridon]] to his [[Parent|father]] [[Harclew]], and was the grandson of [[Amnen Jhoff]]. When he came of age, Jhoff was forcibly enlisted into the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] Navy.<ref name="FACPOV" /> In [[4 ABY]], he served onboard the bridge of the ''Executor'', the personal [[flagship]] of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], as a [[flight controller]]<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> while the ship orbited [[Endor]] with the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] in preparation for an ambush on an attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

When a [[Endor strike team|strike team]] led by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[General]] [[Han Solo]] approached the moon in a [[Tydirium|stolen shuttle]], Jhoff, being observed over the shoulder by [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett]], contacted the ship and requested the proper Imperial codes to proceed. As Solo transmitted the codes, Vader, standing nearby, sensed his son [[Luke Skywalker]] aboard the shuttle and approached Jhoff, asking where the ship was going. Piett leaned over Jhoff's shoulder and requested its cargo and destination, to which Solo responded, claiming that they were transporting a parts and technical crew to Endor. Vader, upon confirming with Piett that they had a proper code clearance, allowed the shuttle to pass. Jhoff once again contacted the ship and informed the shuttle they could proceed on their current course.<ref name="ROTJ" />

A short while later, when the [[Battle of Endor]] broke out, Jhoff was still stationed on the ''Executor{{'s}}'' bridge.<ref name="FACPOV" /> He perished when the ship lost its bridge deflector shields and Rebel pilot [[Arvel Crynyd]] crashed his damaged [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing]] into it,<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Death|killing]] the bridge crew and incinerating Jhoff as he threw his hands in front of his face.<ref name="FACPOV" />

{{Char-stub}}
